marker.description: A yellow paper tag labeled 'B' attached to a thread looped around a specific anatomical structure.

main_question: Identify the structure indicated by the tag labeled 'B'.
main_explanation: The specimen shows a posterior view of the knee region (popliteal fossa). The thread and tag 'B' are attached to a large vessel located deep to the muscles of the fossa, consistent with the position of the popliteal artery.

supporting_question.question: Which nerve is most closely related to the structure indicated by the tag?
supporting_question.explanation: The tibial nerve is the major nerve accompanying the popliteal artery in the popliteal fossa, typically lying medial to the artery.
